name: Painting
description: Painting word search puzzles gather studio English for adults and seniors — brush, canvas, palette, easel, glaze and calm color words — without gallery brands or art-supply slogans. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays familiar and unhurried: landscape, portrait, watercolor, acrylic, hue and light vocabulary many lifelong painters already know. This hub pairs well with Photography and Museums when you want a longer looking afternoon. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as quiet as a still life.
